verdicts.title: Ehrhart Limits
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We introduce the definition of an Ehrhart limit, that is, a formal power series with integer coefficients that is the limit in the ring of formal power series of a sequence of Ehrhart $h^*$-polynomials. We identify a variety of examples of sequences of polytopes that yield Ehrhart limits, with a focus on reflexive polytopes and simplices.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns 'Ehrhart limits' as formal power series limits of h*-polynomial sequences for reflexive polytopes and simplices, with no mention of cohomology, complexity classes, or Boolean function computation. It shares only the 'Ehrhart' vocabulary with the conjecture.

verdicts.title: On the Ehrhart Polynomial of Minimal Matroids
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We provide a formula for the Ehrhart polynomial of the connected matroid of size $n$ and rank $k$ with the least number of bases, also known as a minimal matroid. verdicts.title: Additive number theory and inequalities in Ehrhart theory
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We introduce a powerful connection between Ehrhart theory and additive number theory, and use it to produce infinitely many new classes of inequalities between the coefficients of the $h^*$-polynomial of a lattice polytope.
